brief: Prioritise this aged unit for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with high loading histories have reduced margins against mechanical failure under thermal cycling, as detailed in MG-023. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, as stated in MG-023. Additionally, clear any outstanding vegetation or obstruction defects, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity to maintain airflow for cooling, according to SOP-011.
